raw_text: The private domain carried two layers of filesystem categories, unlike the flat structure of the rest of the store, a remnant of the old filesystem categorizer that materialized cooccurrence cross-product paths as real directories and copied inferences into each. The decision was to flatten to a clean flat-by-domain layout with categories living in the index, deduplicating afterward by keeping the seed-domain (autovivification) copy over the singleton path copy. A snapshot was taken before any migration, following the principle of understanding exact structure before moving files rather than inventing a domain model.
